title: Identity & Model Entitlement
summary: Resolves the calling user, verifies the API key, and rejects any model that is not explicitly named on the caller’s API Product.
onViolation: HTTP 401 / 403 — request never reaches a model

policies.name: DJWT-ExtractUserIdentity
policies.purpose: Extracts the end-user identity from the Cloud IAP / Bearer token for per-user attribution.

policies.name: VA-VerifyAPIKey
policies.purpose: Validates the consumer key and loads API Product metadata (Standard vs Enterprise AI Tier).

policies.name: OAS-ValidateRequest
policies.purpose: Validates the OpenAPI 3.0 request structure and enforces named model entitlements (no wildcards).

title: Prompt & Response Safety
summary: Screens every prompt before a token is spent and inspects every completion on the way out, using one enterprise Model Armor template across all providers.
onViolation: HTTP 403 — blocked at the perimeter with a safety reason

policies.name: SUP-UserPrompt
policies.purpose: Scans the incoming prompt for injection, jailbreak, and PII before any LLM invocation.

policies.name: SMR-SanitizeModelResponse
policies.purpose: Inspects the model output to redact sensitive PII or unsafe completions.

title: Semantic Cache
summary: Matches semantically equivalent prompts against a vector cache and serves them without an upstream call — zero model cost, zero token quota.
onViolation: No rejection — a hit short-circuits the upstream call
configSource: Similarity threshold & TTL on the cache policy

policies.name: SCL-Semantic-Cache-Lookup
policies.purpose: Embeds the incoming prompt and queries the vector store for a high-similarity match.

policies.name: SCP-Semantic-Cache-Populate
policies.purpose: Stores the LLM response on a cache miss so later similar prompts are served locally.

title: Auto-Routing Model Mapping
summary: Classifies each prompt with a small, fast router model and maps the result to a concrete model the caller is entitled to — no model names hardcoded in the proxy.
onViolation: Fails open — falls back to the product default model

policies.name: JS-PrepRouterRequest
policies.purpose: Builds the classifier payload and constrains the answer to coding | deep_reasoning | simple | general.

policies.name: SC-ModelRouter
policies.purpose: Calls the router model with a 2.5s timeout and continue-on-error so a blip degrades rather than fails.

policies.name: JS-AutoRouting
policies.purpose: Maps the returned category to a model using the API Product attributes. Holds no model names of its own.

policies.name: AM-RouteGeminiTarget
policies.purpose: Routes the request to the selected Vertex AI Gemini endpoint.

policies.name: AM-RouteClaudeTarget
policies.purpose: Routes coding prompts on the Enterprise tier to Anthropic Claude on Vertex.

title: Token Quotas & Spend Limits
summary: Budgets by tokens and dollars rather than requests, and checks the prepaid wallet plus active rate plan before the call is allowed through.
onViolation: HTTP 429 quota exceeded / HTTP 403 wallet exhausted
configSource: API Product token quota + wallet balance & rate plan

policies.name: LTQ-TokenEnforce
policies.purpose: Checks accumulated token consumption against the limit resolved from the API Product.

policies.name: LTQ-TokenCount
policies.purpose: Reads the exact token count from the model response and increments the distributed counter.

policies.name: MLC-EnforceMonetizationLimits
policies.purpose: Verifies the prepaid wallet balance and an active rate plan subscription.

title: Cost Attribution & Telemetry
summary: Prices every request from the live rate card, debits the wallet, and emits the analytics dimensions and x-gateway-* trace headers the dashboards run on.

policies.name: KVM-GetModelRates
policies.purpose: Reads the live input/output per-1k token rates from the ai-model-rates KVM.

policies.name: JS-CalculateCost
policies.purpose: Computes the exact USD cost for the request and debits the prepaid developer wallet.

policies.name: DC-ModelAnalytics
policies.purpose: Streams model, token counts, latency, and cost into custom analytics dimensions.

policies.name: AM-SetResponseHeaders
policies.purpose: Injects the x-gateway-* trace headers used by the trace viewer.

title: MCP Protocol Validation
summary: Parses and validates the JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope for tools/list and tools/call so malformed or unsupported agent traffic is rejected at the edge.
onViolation: JSON-RPC error response — request is not bridged

policies.name: PP-MCP
policies.purpose: Parses the incoming JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope (jsonrpc, id, method, params).

policies.name: CORS-Allow
policies.purpose: Enables cross-origin browser and web-agent inspection.

title: Agent Keys & Tool Call Rate Limits
summary: Verifies the agent’s consumer key and caps tool-call rates so a runaway agent loop cannot overwhelm core banking or inventory systems.

policies.name: VA-VerifyAPIKey
policies.purpose: Verifies the agent consumer key against the Enterprise Tools MCP product.

policies.name: Q-Limit
policies.purpose: Enforces per-app request rate limits protecting downstream systems of record.

policies.name: AM-RemoveAuthorization
policies.purpose: Strips client auth headers before forwarding to internal microservices.

title: Persona Tool RBAC
summary: Filters the tool catalog per persona and authorizes each execution, so a Sales agent never discovers — let alone calls — a banking tool.
onViolation: RBAC denied — tool hidden from tools/list, tools/call rejected

policies.name: PP-MCP
policies.purpose: Filters the tools/list response and authorizes tools/call against the product’s tool entitlements.

title: REST → MCP Tool Bridge
summary: Turns existing REST microservices into MCP tools and validates tool arguments against JSON schemas at the gateway — no backend rewrite.
onViolation: Schema validation error returned to the agent
configSource: Tool-to-endpoint mapping in the MCP policy

policies.name: PP-MCP
policies.purpose: Maps the MCP tool name and JSON arguments to the target URL, HTTP verb, and parameters.

title: Tool Execution Audit Log
summary: Streams a structured audit record of every tool invocation — persona, tool, latency, status — to Cloud Logging.

policies.name: ML-CloudLogging
policies.purpose: Streams structured MCP tool execution audit logs to Google Cloud Logging.
